implementation_details.purpose: Provides a simplified, targeted lookup of alert rules by datasource UID. This enables Mimir and Loki rulers to query Grafana for all alert rules associated with their specific datasource, supporting federated alert rule management across the observability stack.
implementation_details.existing_mechanism: Grafana already supports filtering alert rules by datasource UID via the DataSourceUIDs field in ListAlertRulesQuery (pkg/services/ngalert/models/alert_rule.go:1059-1061). The store implementation in alert_rule.go:1086-1092 performs a JSON text search on the 'data' column looking for '"datasourceUid":"<uid>"' patterns. The new ListByDatasource method wraps this existing capability with a cleaner, single-datasource-focused API.

mimir_loki_context.mimir_ruler_store: Mimir's ruler uses pkg/ruler/rulestore/store.go RuleStore interface with methods like ListAllUsers and ListRuleGroupsForUserAndNamespace. Federated rule management through Grafana would bridge Mimir's ruler with Grafana's alert rule storage.
mimir_loki_context.loki_ruler_store: Loki's ruler uses pkg/ruler/rulestore/store.go RuleStore interface with similar methods (ListAllUsers, ListAllRuleGroups, ListRuleGroupsForUserAndNamespace). The new ListByDatasource on Grafana's side allows Loki to retrieve only the alert rules targeting its datasource.
mimir_loki_context.alert_query_datasource: Each AlertRule contains a Data field of type []AlertQuery (pkg/services/ngalert/models/alert_query.go:82). Each AlertQuery has a DatasourceUID field (line 94) that identifies which datasource the query targets. This is the field filtered by ListByDatasource.
